name: Creator & Business Video Sound Palette
description: Production-grade acoustic palette for high-retention vertical reels, investigative breakdowns, and creator videos.

dynamic_cut_padding_rules.principle: Cut padding is dynamic and governed by delivery tempo (WPM), speaker breathing, and narrative energy rather than static fixed offsets.

aggressive_hook.description: Rapid hook opening (0-3s), staccato claims, fast-paced tease

investigative_teardown.description: Data breakdown, document reveals, forensic analysis (Nitin Joshi style)

dramatic_pause.description: Post-revelation silence before verdict or punchline

palette.name: Soft Tactile Click
palette.rule: Use on micro UI movements. Never place on normal caption words.

palette.name: Snappy Mechanical Click
palette.rule: Only trigger when a cursor physically clicks on an interactive target.

palette.name: Damped Kinetic Pop
palette.rule: Max 1 pop per spoken beat. Do not fire on every item in a list simultaneously.

palette.name: Sub-Bass Impact Drop
palette.rule: Sits below vocal frequency band so it never muddies speech. Limit to 1-2 per 45s reel.

palette.name: Heavy Punch Thud
palette.rule: Use when an argument lands with finality. Ensure dialogue volume does not dip.

palette.name: Fast Directional Whip
palette.rule: Only on swift visual displacement. Never on static jump cuts or caption reveals.

palette.name: Cinematic Atmospheric Sweep
palette.rule: Let tail ring out naturally. Keep music lowered during the sweep.

palette.name: Harmonic Tension Riser
triggers: building up to the big evidence reveal
palette.rule: Must resolve cleanly into silence or an impact hit on the exact beat.

palette.name: Glass Metric Ping
palette.rule: Clean high-register indicator. Keeps clarity without competing with vocal mid-range.

palette.name: Warm Insight Chime
palette.rule: Warm and melodic. Avoid jarring high-frequency ring.

palette.name: Acoustic Paper Slide
palette.rule: Organic textured sound for genuine credibility. Must match the visual motion speed.

palette.name: Desk Document Thud
palette.rule: Pairs with paper slide for realistic physical presence.

palette.name: Camera Shutter Transient
palette.rule: Only on photographic freezes or proof capture moments.

palette.name: Debunk Digital Buzzer
palette.rule: Muted and clean; avoid abrasive cartoon sound.

palette.name: Digital Micro-Glitch
triggers: switching from PR clip to raw reality
palette.rule: Use sparingly (<0.3s duration). Never mask spoken vowels.

palette.name: Tactile Keystrokes Flutter
palette.rule: Must match length of simulated typing exactly.

palette.name: Single Key Tap / Return
palette.rule: Punctuate search queries or terminal command execution.

palette.name: Modern Notification Bell
palette.rule: Professional OS style; never loud or jarring.

palette.name: Subtle Shimmer Harmonic
palette.rule: High-frequency air sparkle. Sits far above speech frequencies.

business_investigative.name: Business / Expose Teardown
business_investigative.description: Nitin Joshi, Markets with Jayant style. Voice is paramount; silence is the baseline. Sounds act as forensic evidence stamps.
business_investigative.music_style: minimal dark investigative drone, muted pulsing synth, 60-70 BPM, ducked -19 dB

high_retention_creator.name: High-CTR Modern Creator
high_retention_creator.description: Fast-paced YouTube Shorts / TikTok reels. Snappy, physical, tactile.
high_retention_creator.music_style: upbeat lo-fi / phonk / bass bounce, ducked -16 dB

minimalist_editorial.name: Minimalist Documentary / Case Study
minimalist_editorial.music_style: warm ambient piano / soft strings, ducked -18 dB
